comments.author: Sakura
comments.body:
The quest for this is "A city-state to match Ur". Recognition 4, Archaeology 6, Arabic. I picked the quest up in Calicut, can't remember if I've seen it anywhere else. Prerequisite quest would be "City of ancient Mesopotamia". Discovery is in the Ur inland area, in the northeast.

The quest for this discovery does not appear to be here in the database anywhere.
